reason: Concrete mutation modules have matching tests (order_note_add.py -> test_order_note_add.py, order_void.py -> test_order_void.py), but both outliers are shared helpers: draft_order_cleaner.py holds clean_* functions used by draft_order_create/update, and order_note_common.py is an abstract OrderNoteCommon base (Meta.abstract=True) tested through its subclasses; new helper/base modules would be flagged for nothing (0 of 2). Wording is also vague about how a test file is matched (draft_orders.py maps to test_draft_order_bulk_delete.py).

label: WRONG
reason: Members (auth.py AUTH_HEADER_PREFIXES, jwt.py JWT_* names, db/connection.py TRACEBACK_LIMIT) are fixed literals with no need for configuration; the one outlier, DEFAULT_CURRENCY in the dev-only random_data.py, is the one value that is configurable and mirrors the same os.environ.get('DEFAULT_CURRENCY','USD') in giftcard/models.py, while core/views.py and cleaners/html.py read os.getenv directly too, so no team choice against direct env reads is visible. Hesitated with ACCEPT (routing config through settings.py would be cleaner).

label: ACCEPT
reason: Every enum in error_codes.py files is named *ErrorCode (AccountErrorCode, OrderNoteAddErrorCode, WebhookDryRunErrorCode); ExternalNotificationErrorCodes is the lone plural, and graphql/core/enums.py even re-exposes it as ExternalNotificationTriggerErrorCode, showing it is off-scheme drift. No ruff naming rule (N not selected in pyproject.toml) enforces this.
